rules.height_rules: Bulky housings, stacked equipment or extra height and visual prominence can make a heat pump feel more like external plant than a modest domestic installation.

rules.boundary_rules: Boundary siting and noise are usually the first planning pressure points for heat pumps across Worcestershire, especially where the unit sits near neighbours or a quiet garden edge.
rules.roof_rules: Across Worcestershire, the roof is not usually the main heat-pump lever, but roof-level equipment and exposed service runs are often more sensitive than a discreet installation set lower on the building or in the garden.
rules.materials_rules: Well-scaled screening and restrained finishes usually work better than oversized housings that create a second visual problem around the plant.
